movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Security Gateway Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-823X Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-823X contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary commands on remote devices by sending a POST request to /goform/set_prohibiting via the corresponding function. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Heap Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain privileges or cause a DoS (via heap memory corruption) through user name space.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle E-Business Suite Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Oracle E-Business Suite contains an unspecified vulnerability in the BI Publisher Integration component. The vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Concurrent Processing. Successful attacks can result in takeover of Oracle Concurrent Processing.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Juniper ScreenOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Juniper ScreenOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow unauthorized remote administrative access to the device.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Wing FTP Server Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Wing FTP Server contains an improper neutralization of null byte or NUL character vulnerability that can allow injection of arbitrary Lua code into user session files. This can be used to execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the FTP service (root or SYSTEM by default).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe ColdFusion Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe ColdFusion contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access or modify restricted files via an internet-exposed admin panel.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiManager Missing Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiManager contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the fgfmd daemon that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Hardcoded Credential Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated user to access internal functionality and modify data.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to access restricted functionality. If CVE-2024-8963 is used in conjunction with CVE-2024-8190, an attacker could bypass admin authentication and execute arbitrary commands on the appliance.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-605 Router Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-605 routers contain an information disclosure vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain a username and password by forging a post request to the /getcfg.php page.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains an out-of-bound write vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB WinRAR Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code when a user attempts to view a benign file within a ZIP archive.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mozilla Firefox, Firefox ESR, and Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Mozilla Firefox, Firefox ESR, and Thunderbird contain a use-after-free vulnerability in SVG Animation, targeting Firefox and Tor browser users on Windows.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial of service via a crafted website.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via crafted PNG data in an Office document.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted web site.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Acrobat and Reader allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted PDF file.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mozilla Firefox Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Moxilla Firefox allows remote attackers to bypass the Same Origin Policy to read arbitrary files or gain privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Integer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Integer overflow in Adobe Flash Player allows attackers to execute code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Fusion Middleware Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Unspecified vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Forms Recognition component in Oracle Fusion Middleware allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors related to Designer.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS Webkit Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS WebKit contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted web site. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Dell dbutil Driver Insufficient Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Dell dbutil driver contains an insufficient access control vulnerability which may lead to escalation of privileges, denial-of-service (DoS), or information disclosure.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer have a type confusion vulnerability in mshtml.dll, which allows remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird do not properly handle onreadystatechange events in conjunction with page reloading, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) or possibly execute malicious code via a crafted web site.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle BI Publisher Unauthorized Access Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Oracle BI Publisher, formerly XML Publisher, contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for various unauthorized actions. Open-source reporting attributes this vulnerability to allowing for authentication bypass.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Universal Plug and Play (UPnP) Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows UPnP service improperly allows COM object creation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software SNMP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office software when the software fails to properly handle objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could run arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a use-after-free vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A vulnerability exists in Windows Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) that could allow remote code execution if a user opens a file that contains a specially crafted OLE object.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office MSCOMCTL.OCX Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The TabStrip ActiveX control in the Common Controls in MSCOMCTL.OCX in Microsoft Office allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted (1) document or (2) web page that triggers system-state corruption.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Word Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Word contains a memory corruption vulnerability which when exploited could allow for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Nagios XI OS Command Injection
movers24h.shortDescription: Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management Microkernel Buffer Overflow
movers24h.shortDescription: The Traffic Management Microkernel of BIG-IP ASM Risk Engine has a buffer overflow vulnerability, leading to a bypassing of URL-based access controls.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to wmProgressstat.html.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

movers24h.product: Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows contains remote code execution vulnerability resulting from local drive access preferences not being enforced into the clients' local drives.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chrome FreeType Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chrome uses FreeType, an open-source software library to render fonts, which contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the function Load_SBit_Png when processing PNG images embedded into fonts. This vulnerability is part of an exploit chain with CVE-2020-17087 on Windows and CVE-2020-16010 on Android.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory. Successful exploitation could allow remote code execution in the context of the current user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability in the admin web interface that could allow an authenticated attacker to upload a custom template to perform code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Check Point SmartConsole Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Check Point SmartConsole contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an application login token and use it to authenticate with full administrative privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: iCagenda Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Balbooa Forms Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Balbooa Forms contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload which could allow uploading of executable files leading to full RCE.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

movers7d.product: Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix ADC, Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an information disclosure vulnerability.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: QNAP QTS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: QNAP QTS contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing remote attackers to inject code on the system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DSL-2750B Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: D-Link DSL-2750B devices contain a command injection vulnerability that allows remote, unauthenticated command injection via the login.cgi cli parameter.

movers7d.product: ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: HP Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: HP ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a marshalled object to (1) EJBInvokerServlet or (2) JMXInvokerServlet.

movers7d.product: Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix ADC, Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an information disclosure vulnerability.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Roundcube Webmail Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Roundcube Webmail contains an remote code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code via shell metacharacters in a configuration setting for im_convert_path or im_identify_path.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SaltStack Salt Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Netis WF2419 Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.

movers7d.product: Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix ADC, Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that may allow unauthenticated access to certain URL endpoints. The attacker must have access to the NetScaler IP (NSIP) in order to perform exploitation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Linux JBoss Seam 2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: JBoss Seam 2 (jboss-seam2), as used in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3.0 for Red Hat Linux, allows attackers to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability can only be exploited when the Java Security Manager is not properly configured.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ImageMagick Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ImageMagick contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow users to delete files by using ImageMagick's 'ephemeral' pseudo protocol, which deletes files after reading.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: DD-WRT Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: DD-WRT contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to overflow an internal buffer used by UPnP and trigger a code execution vulnerability.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DCS-930L Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: setSystemCommand on D-Link DCS-930L devices allows a remote attacker to execute code via an OS command.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: GNU C Library Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: GNU C Library's dynamic loader ld.so contains a buffer overflow vulnerability when processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable, allowing a local attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Yealink Device Management Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Unified Communications Products Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM), Cisco Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (Unified CM SME), Cisco Unified Communications Manager IM & Presence Service (Unified CM IM&P), Cisco Unity Connection, and Cisco Webex Calling Dedicated Instance contain a code injection vulnerability that could allow the attacker to obtain user-level access to the underlying operating system and then elevate privileges to root.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition Path Transversal
movers7d.shortDescription: Path traversal vulnerability, where an attacker can target the preview FilePath parameter of the getPreviewImage function to get access to arbitrary system file.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Multiple Archer Devices Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in multiple TP-Link Archer devices allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the PATH_INFO to login/.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a PDF file with long arguments to unspecified JavaScript methods.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Arbitrary Integer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Integer overflow vulnerability in Adobe Reader and Acrobat allows attackers to execute remote code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Kentico Xperience Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Kentico contains a failure to validate security headers. This deserialization can led to unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WhatsApp VOIP Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A buffer overflow vulnerability in WhatsApp VOIP stack allowed remote code execution via specially crafted series of RTCP packets sent to a target phone number.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to achieve code execution in the context of the current user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PlaySMS Server-Side Template Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Double Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader have a double free vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SaltStack Salt Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to cipher sensitive data in FortiOS configuration backup file via knowledge of the hard-coded key.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fuel CMS SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: FUEL CMS 1.4.7 allows SQL Injection via the col parameter to /pages/items, /permissions/items, or /navigation/items.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

newest.vulnerabilityName: Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.

newest.product: Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
newest.vulnerabilityName: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab XML Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information, including internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Not Failing Securely Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component due to insufficient file type validation that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Weak Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.

newest.vulnerabilityName: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

newest.vulnerabilityName: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

newest.vulnerabilityName: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

newest.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.
